landing.headline: Run your whole store from one screen.
landing.lead: Products, stock, purchases, sales, returns, expenses and staff — one production-ready platform with real-time reporting and fine-grained access control.
landing.cta_title: Open your till in five minutes.
landing.cta_lead: Import your product list, set roles, start selling.
feature.products.title: Products & stock
feature.products.body: Variants, barcodes, multi-warehouse counts and low-stock thresholds that fire before you run dry.
feature.sales.title: Sales & returns
feature.sales.body: Quotes, orders, partial payments and credit notes — every movement journalled and reversible.
feature.purchases.title: Purchases & suppliers
feature.purchases.body: Purchase orders, receipts and supplier balances reconciled against what actually landed.
feature.roles.title: Roles & permissions
feature.roles.body: Per-screen and per-action gates, so cashiers see the till and only the owner sees margins.
feature.reporting.title: Reporting
feature.reporting.body: Revenue, COGS, gross profit, receivables and debts on any date range — exportable.
feature.expenses.title: Expenses & staff
feature.expenses.body: Shift logs, categorised expenses and daily cash-up that ties out at close of business.
